summary.business_type: SaaS Web Application (free AI YouTube SEO tool)
top_findings: All 2026-08-03 critical/high issues verified fixed and live
CSS pipeline fixed: no data: URI CSP blocks, no duplicate stylesheet sets (~428KB saved)
WebP adoption complete: 102 blog heroes + homepage dashboard hero
llms.txt regenerated: 54 posts + 98 tools + 150 glossary terms, clean descriptions
Remaining: external authority (backlinks, owned domain, Google API creds for field CWV)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Sitemap 0% broken (was 28.75%) — 250/250 sampled URLs return 200
Security headers complete: HSTS preload, CSP, XFO, nosniff, Referrer-Policy
robots.txt exemplary AI-crawler policy
No soft-404s; real 404s for nonexistent URLs
Immutable caching on /assets/* and /js/*
CSP whitelists cdn.jsdelivr.net (Vercel Analytics works)

findings.title: Secondary AI training crawlers not addressed in robots.txt
findings.description: 11 secondary crawlers (GrokBot, Amazonbot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Cohere-Research, YouBot, etc.) have no explicit rules — silently allowed by User-agent: * catch-all. If training-block intent is desired, they should be disallowed.
findings.recommendation: Add Disallow rules for training crawlers (GrokBot, Amazonbot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Cohere-Research, AI2Bot, etc.) while keeping search/AI-answer crawlers allowed.

findings.title: lastmod missing on glossary sitemap entries
findings.description: 17,682 glossary URLs have no lastmod (removed to avoid build-stamp distrust). Google treats them as unknown freshness.
findings.recommendation: Emit real per-term lastmod from glossary-data.json, or accept unknown freshness for programmatic terms.

findings.title: Divergent CSPs across routes
findings.description: vercel.json CSP (comprehensive) vs helmet short CSP on some API routes.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to a single CSP definition.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: All 98 tool pages now 500+ visible words with how-to + FAQ + related tools (verified live: 552-589 words sampled)
Category hubs expanded to 500+ words with CollectionPage schema
Named author Patrick in Person schema + bylines + meta author
About page 1,232 words with founder attribution
Zero thin pages (<300 words) found in scan

findings.title: Some tool-page FAQ content uses shared boilerplate
findings.description: Fallback content template shared across ~78 tool pages; 20 have custom niche content. Not duplicate (topic-specific), but lower uniqueness than ideal.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize custom content for highest-traffic tools; acceptable for long-tail.

categories.name: On-Page SEO

Meta descriptions present on all sampled pages
1 H1 per page site-wide (scan verified 0 multi-H1)
Canonicals clean — no 3xx targets

findings.title: Homepage H1 spacing typo
findings.description: H1 renders 'Generator.100% Free, Unlimited.' — missing space after period (line break artifact).

findings.title: Tool inventory count mismatch
findings.description: Hub links 23 tools vs title/meta '90+' vs llms.txt 98. Multiple URL forms exist (/tools/X, /tools.html, /public/tools/X.html).
findings.recommendation: Consolidate tool URL forms; align displayed count with linked count.
